routes.claim: The exact parent derived index retained absolute machine paths in 11 of 12 failure tails.
routes.passCondition: Exact parent Git blobs expose raw capture and verbatim ingestion, while the receipt retains only counts.
routes.counterevidence: No absolute tails, a pre-existing redactor, or a receipt containing the leaked text.
routes.namedSeam: Baseline counts prove the bounded leak, not all historical privacy debt.

routes.claim: Known roots and residual Windows, UNC, POSIX, and file-URL paths are redacted.
routes.passCondition: Synthetic cross-platform fixtures emit typed placeholders and contain none of the input absolute roots.
routes.counterevidence: Any fixture retains an absolute root or host/share identity.
routes.namedSeam: Pattern fixtures do not prove general secret detection.

routes.claim: Relative context, web URLs, exact output hashes, tail bounds, and source receipt immutability are preserved.
routes.passCondition: Selftests preserve declared context, bound tails after redaction, and leave source input unchanged; generator keeps raw outputSha256.
routes.primarySurface: Direct selftest plus product source snapshot
routes.counterevidence: Redaction mutates input, removes declared relative context, exceeds the bound, or hashes rewritten output.
routes.namedSeam: A shallow result copy preserves unrelated nested references by design.

routes.claim: Receipt creation and readiness ingestion both apply the shared redactor.
routes.passCondition: Generator/daily writer source calls the helper and a fresh synthetic readiness fixture sanitizes a raw legacy result without mutating it.
routes.primarySurface: Source snapshot and CLEAN_PRODUCT_REPLAY.json synthetic ingestion
routes.counterevidence: A raw supplied receipt reaches the derived index or a writer retains an unredacted failure tail.
routes.namedSeam: No retroactive mutation of ignored or external receipts is claimed.

routes.claim: Every current retained tools-index failure tail is path-redacted and bounded.
routes.passCondition: All 12 retained tails are stable under a second redaction pass and at most 1200 characters.
routes.counterevidence: Any tail changes under redaction or exceeds its limit.
routes.namedSeam: Only retained failureTail fields in the current derived index are covered.

routes.claim: The bounded product preserves Workshop structural checks.
routes.passCondition: All ten AGENTS.md commands and all focused commands exit zero.
routes.counterevidence: Any recorded required or focused command is non-pass.
routes.namedSeam: Script checks are not a browser journey.

routes.claim: Readiness passes while the operations aggregate retains an unrelated missing-intake failure.
routes.passCondition: Readiness exits zero; operations reaches inherited recovery then fails at an unchanged absent intake boundary.
routes.counterevidence: The failing service/script changed, the intake exists, or the aggregate failure is labeled pass.
routes.namedSeam: The operations aggregate itself is not passing.

routes.claim: The exact product slice reproduces redaction and ingestion without tracked mutation.
routes.passCondition: Archived product Git objects pass five commands and fresh synthetic ingestion with all 15 tracked files unchanged.
routes.counterevidence: Identity mismatch, a failed check, retained absolute fixture root, changed tracked file, or leftover replay path.
routes.namedSeam: This is a selected product slice, not a full clean-repository replay.

routes.claim: No browser behavior or broader privacy scope is claimed.
routes.passCondition: Product diff changes no browser-facing file and receipts explicitly deny browser, secret, arbitrary-field, and full-audit proof.
routes.counterevidence: A changed browser surface, live-browser claim, or broad privacy claim.
routes.namedSeam: The native surface is Node diagnostic text and JSON.

routes.claim: The seam grants no promotion, merge, Foundation, or CANON authority.
routes.passCondition: Truth receipts deny authority and Mike Tobi / AXM remains the named gate.
routes.counterevidence: Any automatic promotion or CANON claim.
routes.namedSeam: Passing tests produce review material only.
